“Jr.”
admin
06 Jun 2021
0 Comments
Dead on the spot sa gilid ng kalsada ang isang lalaki matapos umanong mauwi sa engkwentro ang anti-drug operation ng pulisya sa Barangay Santo Cristo, bayan ng Pulilan, Bulacan.
Batay sa impormasyon mula sa PNP Regional Office 3, kilala sa alyas JR ang napatay na suspek, habang nakatakas naman sa gitna ng engkwentro ang kasamahan niyang lalaki sakay ng isang motorsiklo. Dead on the spot sa gilid ng kalsada ang isang lalaki matapos umanong mauwi sa engkwentro ang anti-drug operation ng pulisya sa Barangay Santo Cristo, bayan ng Pulilan, Bulacan.
Alias: Jr Sex: Male
Incident Details
Killed in police operation in public Date of Incident: May 2, 2021 Location of Incident: Pulilan, Bulacan
Source(s)
https://www.facebook.com/rematetabloid/posts/4111987698821280 https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/05/03/21/tulak-umano-ng-droga-patay-sa-buy-bust-sa-bulacan
Patay ang isang hinihinalang tulak ng iligal na droga habang nakatakas ang kasamahan nito sa ikinasang buy-bust operation ng pulisya sa Pulilan ng lalawigang ito kahapon. Kinilala ni Bulacan Police director P/Col. Lawrence Cajipe ang napatay na may alyas lamang na Jr.
Sa report, ikinasa ang operasyon nang pinagsanib na puwersa ng Provincial Intelligence Unit at Pulilan police sa Brgy. Sto. Cristo.
Sinasabing nakatakas sa operasyon ang kasamahan lulan ng Rusi motorcycle.
Narekober sa operasyon ang revolver, mga basyo, 29 sachet na pinaghihinalaang shabu na tumimbang ng tatlong gramo at may estimated street value na P20,400 at P1,000 marked money.

0 Comments
The report said the suspect, who had a handgun, fired at the policemen, who retaliated and shot Rodriguez dead.
Sex: Male
Incident Details
Killed in police operation Date of Incident: May 26, 2021 Location of Incident: Lucena, Laguna
Source(s)
https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1436932/suspected-criminal-slain-in-batangas-town
A suspected criminal was killed in an armed encounter with police in Balayan town in Batangas province early Wednesday.
The Calabarzon police said in a spot report that policemen, armed with a search warrant, swooped down on the house of Antonio Rodriguez in Barangay 1 at 4:20 a.m.
The report said the suspect, who had a handgun, fired at the policemen, who retaliated and shot Rodriguez dead.
The police said the search warrant targeted illegal drugs and illegal firearms.

Llaga was selling a sachet of suspected shabu (crystal meth) to an undercover police operative.
Sensing that it was a set-up, Llaga drew his handgun and fired at the police operative, prompting them to retaliate and kill him on the spot.
Sex: Male
Incident Details
Killed in police operation in public Date of Incident: May 24, 2021 Time of Incident: 10:45 pm Location of Incident: Daraga, Albay
Source(s)
https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1436341/2-suspected-drug-pushers-slain-in-shootouts-with-cops-in-bicol
In Daraga town, Albay, Eugen Llaga, a high-value target, died in a shootout during an anti-drug operation in Barangay Binitayan around 10:45 p.m. Monday.
Llaga was selling a sachet of suspected shabu (crystal meth) to an undercover police operative.
Sensing that it was a set-up, Llaga drew his handgun and fired at the police operative, prompting them to retaliate and kill him on the spot.

Christopher “Amping” Cuan
admin
12 Jan 2021
0 Comments
Reports said his name was delisted but on Jan. 8, 2019, he was shot by unidentified gunmen in front of the Libungan town hall but survived.
Alias: Amping Sex: Male Occupation: Mayor
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants Date of Incident: January 11, 2021 Location of Incident: Libungan, Cotabato
Source(s)
https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1382121/mayor-in-dutertes-drug-list-driver-slain-in-cotabato-town-gun-attack https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1382382/another-man-on-du30-narcolist-gunned-down
Barely two years ago, on January 7, 2019, Libungan Mayor Christopher “Amping” Cuan was inside town hall here around 1:45 p.m. when an unidentified gunman opened fire and missed, according to the police’ account of the incident.
But on Monday, the 46-year-old mayor was not as lucky. He was inspecting a cockfighting arena still under construction near his home in Barangay Cabaruyan when another attacker shot him and his driver Edwin Navarro Ihao, 36. Both died on the spot.
Cuan’s name had been on President Duterte’s list of drug suspects in 2016, but he had vehemently denied he was involved in illegal drugs and sought out the help of the then Philippine National Police (PNP) Director Gen. Ronaldo Dela Rosa in Camp Crame to clear his name.
Cuan followed the long list of mayors and politicians in the President’s drug watchlist who were later killed by unidentified gunmen. On July 10 last year, Mayor Pablo Matinong of Sto Niño town of South Cotabato was also killed. Matinong, who was also on the President’s list, repeatedly denied he was involved in the illegal drug trade.

Caesar Perez
admin
07 Dec 2020
0 Comments
Perez had repeatedly denied involvement in the drug trade, after he was named in the 2017 National Police Commission’s list of alleged narco-politicians.
Occupation: Mayor
Incident Details
Killed by unknown assailants in public Date of Incident: December 3, 2020 Location of Incident: Los Banos, Laguna
Source(s)
https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1368203/shock-rage-in-los-banos-over-mayors-slay https://www.rappler.com/nation/los-banos-laguna-mayor-shot-december-3-2020 https://interaksyon.philstar.com/politics-issues/2020/12/04/181618/university-philippines-uplb-caesar-perez-killed/
At 8:45 p.m., Perez asked his driver and another assistant to drive the masseuse home. The mayor then went to feed his carp and took a stroll out in the open area of the town hall when two gunshots rang out.
Perez’s family has remained silent over the incident. They were holding the wake at his home but there were plans to move the wake later to the town hall.
“To [whoever did this], I hope his conscience bothers him. We lost a good mayor who had far, bigger dreams for Los Baños. We trusted him,” said store owner, Melissa Santillan, 55.
Perez had repeatedly denied involvement in the drug trade, after he was named in the 2017 National Police Commission’s list of alleged narco-politicians.
In that same year, Perez’s younger brother, Ruel, was gunned down by motorcycle-riding assailants at Barangay Maahas here.
In 2018, another mayor on the government’s narcolist, Antonio Halili of Tanauan City in Batangas province, was assassinated during a flag-raising ceremony at the City Hall.
